title: Distinguish verified remote federation refusals from local authority errors
outcome: Automatic qualification can describe and classify a MAC-verified remote refusal separately from local stale-authority or authentication errors.
acceptance: RPC errors carry provenance distinguishing a post-MAC remote 401/403/409 from local stale-link and missing/invalid-MAC errors without weakening authentication or authority fences.
Tests cover unsigned or invalid-MAC responses and local lease races alongside verified refusals; retry/retirement behavior and diagnostic reasons are explicit.
